services.name: Southern Star Special Event Cruise
services.desc: Special Events: Valentine's Day Cruise: In February, enjoy a relaxing 90-minute Sunset Dolphin Cruise with your Valentine aboard Southern Star--Destin's Original Dolphin Cruise! Cruise the pristine waters of the world's most beautiful beaches. Experience up close viewing of playful Atlantic Coastal Bottlenose Dolphins in their natural habitat. View seabirds and a variety of other marine life. Take in a spectacular Destin sunset just before returning to the dock. Includes one complimentary beer or wine per person with valid ID $60 per couple ($30.00 per person) Christmas Boat Parade: In Join us for a Destin Tradition--Christmas Boat Parade

services.name: Southern Star Dolphin Cruise--Destin's Original Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Witness the extraordinary aboard the Southern Star---Destin's Original Dolphin Cruise! Observe Coastal Bottlenose Dolphins in their natural habitat on our family-friendly adventure. Experience up-close viewing of dolphins, seabirds, and a variety of marine life. Cruise the pristine waters of the Emerald Coast while relaxing to the sounds of island music aboard our glass-bottom boat. Our fully-narrated eco-tour provides fun for all ages and evening cruises take in spectacular sunsets. Destin's original and highest rated Dolphin Tour! Come have fun with us! A little about our Narrated 1.5-hour Southern Star dolphin ecotour offering family-friendly wildlife viewing

services.name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: The Most Beautiful Sunset Cruise in Destin, FL Aboard the Southern Star® What better way to end your day than soaking in a beautiful, painted sky while cruising the pristine Destin, Florida waters! Sunset cruises are one of the most breathtaking ways to experience the splendor of the Emerald Coast. Enjoy a refreshing beverage, while we cruise the Destin Harbor and East Pass, as our skilled Captain finds the perfect spot to watch the sun sink below the horizon. Our sunset dolphin cruises follow the same structure as our regular dolphin cruise offerings, with an exclamation point of a beautiful 1.5-hour sunset cruise aboard Southern Star for golden-hour views and dolphin watching

services.name: Fireworks Cruise aboard the SOUTHERN STAR
services.desc: Experience stunning views of the HarborWalk Village fireworks spectacular over the East Pass. We depart the dock after dark with the sole purpose of getting an up-close vantage point of the fireworks displays. Our Fireworks Cruises do not include dolphin-watching. Please join us aboard the Southern Star as we take in the fireworks display with an up-close and unobstructed vantage point that promises to be family-friendly, and fun for all ages! All Cruises subject to attaining minimum passenger count and weather Seasonal fireworks cruise aboard Southern Star with waterfront night views

services.name: Buccaneer Pirate Cruise
services.desc: Embark on the adventure of a lifetime aboard the Buccaneer Pirate Cruise! Join us as we take to the seas of the Emerald Coast in search of undiscovered treasure. Entertainment and interaction create adventure, excitement, and merriment for the young and young at heart. Our captain and mates will amuse the whole crew from beginning to end with pirate-themed activities, story-telling, singing, and dancing. The crew engages willing participants in pirate training, sword fighting, water gun battles, a treasure hunt, and authentic cannon fire! Parents are welcome to join in with the Interactive family pirate cruise aboard the Buccaneer with games and themed entertainment

services.name: Dolphins and Doughnuts Cruise
services.desc: Relaxing Morning Dolphin Cruise with Complimentary Doughnuts Enjoy the peace of a Destin morning with a relaxing scenic cruise aboard the Southern Star! Doughnuts will be served compliments of Parlor Doughnuts as you cruise our picturesque Emerald Coast waters and observe dolphins in their natural habitat. Iced Coffee, Mimosas, and Bloody Marys will be available for purchase as well, so you can kick back and unwind. Mornings are the time of day when our waters are typically the clearest, giving us the best chance of seeing a variety of marine life as we search for and watch dolphins swimming

policies: Parties not boarded by this time forfeit tickets to guests on the wait list.
As safety is our top priority, weather cancellations are made on a cruise by cruise basis up to time of departure.
If an activity is cut short early due to severe weather, rainchecks will be given to all guests.
Refund and Rescheduling Policy All sales are final, unless trip protection is purchased up front.
Trip Protection allows for rescheduling (subject to availability) or refund of tickets up to 120 minutes prior to departure time, for any reason.
Tickets purchased within 120 minutes of cruise departure will be a final sale, and non-refundable.
In the event of a closure due to inclement weather, tickets may be redeemed during the same week.
Purchasing Trip protection allows you to cancel or reschedule your activity at any time for any reason during the day of your scheduled activity.
